Billed yearly, $540 a year. Credits refill monthly, and you can stop at renewal.

  • Unlimited users. Adding people is free. You pay for the work Maia does, never per seat.

A credit is a unit of Maia's work

Model calls draw credits down as they happen, so a quiet week costs almost nothing and a busy one costs what it used. Routing sends routine work to cheaper models, which is why credits stretch.

Start free, then pick a size

$50 lands when you link your workspace, no card. When it runs down, pick a monthly package that refills on the same day each month, or top up once. The console shows where credits went and flags a low balance.

Enterprise is a conversation

Volume pricing, your own infrastructure, your own model keys, invoicing and a named person to call. Tell us how you buy and we will shape it with you.
